name: Freight Lift Override
setup: The tower is in level 3 containment: passenger lifts dead, stairwells shuttered. The freight lift wants a four-digit duty engineering override on a keypad inside the car.
solution: Enter 3042, the lift car's inspection number from the foil sticker inside the car. Not 1987, the year on the lobby plaque.
failure: A wrong code is announced over the lobby PA, which brings the two security Husks back through the shutters, and the keypad locks out for 10 seconds per wrong entry. Entering 1987 gets its own drier refusal line.
hint_1: Four digits on a keypad, and a building full of people who write things down. Somebody told somebody that code.
hint_2: Read the facilities email on the reception terminal again. She says she moved it to the lift car's inspection number.
hint_3: It's the sticker inside the car, at your shoulder. Three zero four two. Not the year on the plaque.
hint_trigger: Hint 1 after 60 s at the keypad or 1 wrong entry; hint 2 after 2 min or 2 wrong entries; hint 3 after 3 min 30 s or 4 wrong entries.

name: Genetics Vault Sequencer
setup: Antidote component B sits in a cold drawer inside the Genetics vault, a special room on floor 31. The vault door has three thumbwheels, each cycling the bases A, C, G, T, read left to right.
solution: Set the three dials to G, T, C, left to right: the V-7 marker printed on every vial label in the building, loaded in the order Calder's requisition specifies.
failure: A wrong triplet throws the vault's cold alarm: strobe, cold vent, a 25-second window in which two Husks arrive from the open-plan benches, and a 15-second dead bolt on the door. Spawns come from a capped pool.
hint_1: Three dials, three letters. That's a code they used every day, so it'll be printed on something they handled every day.
hint_2: The tech's last page said it's on the labels. Pick a vial off the bench rack and read the marker line.
hint_3: G, T, C. Left to right, the way Calder's requisition says to load the drawer.
hint_trigger: Hint 1 after 90 s or 1 wrong triplet; hint 2 after 3 min or 2 wrong triplets; hint 3 after 4 min 30 s or 4 wrong triplets.

name: Cryo Rack Interlock
setup: Antidote component C is clamped in a cryo rack on floor 33. The interlock reads bays 31, 32 and 33 as one set and lifts only when all three agree. Leon finds them at minus 80, minus 20 and OFF, with bay 33's compressor tripped.
solution: Hit the reset button on bay 33's flank, then set all three bay dials to minus 80. The rack lifts.
failure: Any bay left at minus 196 cracks the frost line: a loud alarm at the loading bay that calls the two Brutes in early, and the rack stays shut. Bays left at OFF or minus 20 just hold the interlock lamp amber, so the player is slowed, never hard-blocked.
hint_1: Three bays, three different temperatures, and a rack that won't open. It's not asking you to be clever, it's asking you to be tidy.
hint_2: The cryo log says the interlock reads all three bays as one set. Somebody left one thawing and another one tripped out.
hint_3: Reset bay 33's compressor, then put all three to minus eighty. Not lower. Minus one ninety-six cracks the line and screams.
hint_trigger: Hint 1 after 90 s in the bay room; hint 2 after 3 min or 1 wrong set; hint 3 after 4 min, 2 wrong sets, or immediately after the minus 196 alarm.

name: Antidote Synthesis
setup: Voss's rig in the Crown Lab: three carrier ports and a keypad. It will not arm with an empty port and rejects any inactivation sequence it does not recognise. The cycle runs 90 seconds with the hood down and cannot be interrupted.
solution: Load component A from the Annex (KEY_C3_AntidoteA), B and C into their ports, then key in the cold-shock sequence found in the Annex trial log (see Chapter 3), gated on FLG_C3_ColdShockKnown. Press RUN and hold the lab for 90 seconds against three Husk waves, then draw the dose.
failure: A missing component: the rig refuses to arm and names the empty port. A wrong sequence: rejected, vents, 20-second lockout. Leon dying during the cycle: checkpoint restores to the moment RUN was pressed with ports loaded and sequence accepted, so the retry is of the fight, not the puzzle.
hint_1: Three ports, three carriers. It won't even arm until all three are in.
hint_2: Then it wants the inactivation sequence. His own sheet says it only ever existed in one place, and you've already been there.
hint_3: The cold-shock sequence from the Annex trial log, Leon. Owen's floor. Key it in exactly as it was written and hit RUN.
hint_trigger: Hint 1 after 45 s at the rig with any port empty; hint 2 after 60 s at the keypad with all ports loaded; hint 3 after 2 min or 2 rejected sequences.

name: Voss's Dosing Manifold
setup: The roof plant room after the boss. Three brass handles, PURGE, RESERVOIR BYPASS and CITY MAIN, plus a pump switch. The loop still holds about 400 litres of Voss's concentrate, and his timer is counting to 06:12.
solution: Open PURGE and hold it until the sump gauge clears, shut RESERVOIR BYPASS, open CITY MAIN, then start the pump. In that order.
failure: Not a game over. Opening CITY MAIN early starts the concentrate moving; Mara catches it on the north readout within four seconds and shouts. Shutting it inside that window costs nothing. Riding it out forces a checkpoint reload at the plant room door with hint 3 already playing. Skipping the purge flushes the concentrate to the reservoir branch and the pump refuses to run until the loop is clear.
hint_1: Three handles and a pump switch. Get the order wrong and you send his batch instead of yours.
hint_2: The mechanic wrote the order on his work order downstairs, and Voss copied it onto the clipboard right there. Clear the loop first.
hint_3: Purge. Then shut the reservoir bypass. Then open the city main, then the pump. In that order, Leon.
hint_trigger: Hint 1 after 30 s in the plant room; hint 2 after 70 s or 1 wrong handle; hint 3 after 2 min, 2 wrong handles, or any concentrate movement.
